source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Requirement Gathering (PDF 6).

blocks.text: Is pehli phase (marhale) mein maqsad yeh samajhna aur jama karna hai ke software ko kya kaam karna hai. Is ke liye un logon se baat ki jati hai jo software istemal karenge, aur doosre stakeholders (jin ka project se talluq hai) se bhi, ta ke un ki zarooratein aur tawaqqo (expectations) maloom hon. Misal: agar aap school ke liye nayi app bana rahe hain to students, teachers aur administrators se poochenge ke woh app mein kaun se features dekhna chahte hain.
Is phase ke aham kaam (key activities):

items: Interviews and Surveys: mumkina users se sawal poochna aur un ki raaye (feedback) jama karna ta ke un ki zarooratein aur pasand samajh aayein.
Observations (mushahida): dekhna ke users maujooda systems ko kaise istemal karte hain, ta ke masle aur behtari ke mauqe nazar aayein.
Document Review: pehle se maujood documents, jaise reports aur user manuals, parhna ta ke requirements ke baare mein mazeed maloomat milein.

blocks.title: Did You Know? (Kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Requirement gathering kisi bari taqreeb, jaise shaadi, ki planning jaisa hai. Jaise dulha dulhan ki pasand jaanna zaroori hai, waise hi developers ko jaanna zaroori hai ke users software se kya chahte hain.

blocks.prompt: Requirement gathering ki teen aham activities bataein aur har ek ka kaam likhein.
blocks.explanation: Interviews and Surveys: users se seedha sawal poochna aur feedback lena. Observations: dekhna ke users maujooda system kaise chalate hain aur kahan mushkil hoti hai. Document Review: reports aur user manuals se mazeed maloomat lena.

items: Requirement Gathering: pehli phase; users aur stakeholders se maloom karna ke software ko kya karna hai.
Activities: interviews aur surveys, observations, document review.
